correctness.rationale: PASS: For char!=2 trace pairing B nondegenerate, a rank-one map R(x)=B(w,x)v is RB iff [w,v] is a multiple of w. The sl2 centralizer gives diagonal D and nilpotent normalizer gives F={w isotropic,B(v,w)=0}. Binary quadratic factorization identifies reduced D=P2, F=P1xP1 and intersection conic; rational projective count (q²+q+1)+(q+1)²-(q+1)=2q²+2q+1. PGL2 stabilizers yield split/nonsplit and nilpotent square-class orbit sizes. Independently checked all 13² projective line pairs over F3 against the criterion (25 valid; 50 nonzero maps).
